project_name: hyrz - Flexible Staffing Platform Work Chats

css_specs.pure_css_doodle_pattern: background-color: #FAF5EE; background-image: radial-gradient(#3B11240F 1.3px, transparent 1.5px), radial-gradient(#3B11240F 1.3px, transparent 1.5px); background-size: 24px 24px; background-position: 0 0, 12px 12px;
css_specs.bubble_tail_approach: .tail.theirs .hz-bubble::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:-7px; width:8px; height:12px; background:inherit; clip-path:polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%); } .tail.mine .hz-bubble::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:0; right:-7px; width:8px; height:12px; background:inherit; clip-path:polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%); }
css_specs.pinned_bar_spec: position:sticky; top:0; z-index:5; background:#FFFFFFEF; backdrop-filter:blur(10px); border-bottom:1px solid #F0E1E7; padding:8px 14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(59, 17, 36, 0.06);
css_specs.chat_list_row_spec: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:12px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid #F4E8ED; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 0.15s ease;
css_specs.micro_interactions: Hover actions scale(1.08) on coral buttons; bubble reaction pop animation keyframes hzPop { 0%{transform:scale(0.5);opacity:0} 70%{transform:scale(1.08)} 100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1} }; smooth message entry slide-up.

key_functionalities: Group workchat room with Deep Plum (#3B1124) header, participant count/avatars, back button, and info trigger
Collapsible WhatsApp-style pinned messages bar with icon and message preview
Message bubbles with distinct participant colors on white for incoming messages, soft blush (#F9E2EC) for own messages
Coral ticks (#FF5C67) for read receipts, timestamps, and styled reply quote blocks inside bubbles
Emoji reaction chips beneath bubbles with count badges and user toggle
Date separators and shift reminder system notifications in golden-warm pill cards
GIF and photo attachments with inline preview and full lightbox
Composer with attachment tools (emoji, GIF, photo), rounded input, and coral send button with typing indicator
Chat list view with avatar, title, snippet, time, and unread notification badge

accessibility.contrast_verification: All text colors on white and blush bubbles meet WCAG AA standards (APCA tested). Sender name palette optimized for high contrast on white background.
accessibility.testing_attribute: data-testid present on all key chat elements (e.g. data-testid='chat-header', data-testid='chat-message-bubble', data-testid='chat-composer-send-button', data-testid='pinned-message-bar')

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply exact hex tokens defined in exact_hex_tokens to client/src/ui/chat/chat.css and styles.css
Ensure both mobile 390px and desktop 1920px viewports center the chat inside a max-width 900px container or full modal overlay
Verify testing attributes data-testid on interactive buttons and message elements
Ensure 1:1 direct chats and group workchats share the Plum and Blush design system for consistency

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Use Plum and Blush palette with WhatsApp chat aesthetics. Never use generic blue gradients.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: All interactive and informational chat elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all. Specify properties like transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive: Mobile-first responsive design supporting 390px viewport to 1920px desktop view.
